capabilities: Walk attachments and linked notes into a checkbox dependency tree
Export a bundle or ZIP that keeps vault-relative paths
Render checked notes as an EPUB or PDF document
Offer backlinks as optional unchecked files
Show a live file count and total size before writing
disambiguation: Not a Markdown format converter; it collects notes, attachments and linked notes into a bundle, EPUB or PDF.
extras: Full documentation is a separate demo vault shipped with each release and readable on GitHub; beta builds install through BRAT. On mobile the bundle goes to a vault-relative folder because there is no system directory picker.
intentEvidence: Alternative workflow: reviewed bundle export with linked-note traversal
problem: A note sent on its own arrives with missing images and dead links, while copying the whole folder shares too much.

relations.evidence: Overlapping formats (Markdown bundle, EPUB, PDF); adds: linked notes and attachments offered in a tree
Same EPUB output; different selection: notes reached through links, picked in a tree
Same ZIP goal; per-file selection; mobile too
Same bundle goal; reviewed file tree with per-file choices; no depth setting
Same bundle goal; preserves separate paths and offers per-file choices

summary: Exports a note, folder or selection together with its attachments and linked notes, picked in a checkbox tree, as a bundle, ZIP, EPUB or PDF.
